articles.title: ‘BKU’ star Nivin Pauly talks about the success of Mamitha Baiju starrer; shares details about his villainous role in Lokesh Cinematic Universe, ‘Playing an antagonist will surprise audience’
articles.summary: Malayalam actor Nivin Pauly led Mollywood’s ‘Bethlehem Kudumba Unit’ starring alongside Mamitha Baiju, directed by Girish AD.
articles.body: Malayalam actor Nivin Pauly led Mollywood’s ‘Bethlehem Kudumba Unit’ starring alongside Mamitha Baiju, directed by Girish AD. The film became Mollywood’s highest-grossing release minting over Rs. 331 crore, surpassing the 2025 blockbuster Lokah: Chapter 1. The actor shared his take on how the film achieved such success. He also spoke about playing an antagonist in Lokesh Cinematic Universe and about other projects and shared updates about his upcoming projects.In a recent conversation with Variety India, Nivin Pauly shared that he did not expect the simple, small-town story to achieve such a major theatrical success. He said the film’s emotional connection with audiences played a key role in its performance.Nivin Pauly on Bethlehem Kudumba Unit’s Box Office success“People often assume that a film needs a huge budget, big sets, foreign locations, and a grand scale to break box-office records. This simple film has done that and I think it surprised everyone, including us. The truth is that when a film connects with people emotionally and is made with sincerity and honesty, audiences respond. They want something they can relate to—something that helps them relax and disconnect from stress for a few hours. The biggest compliment I received was that the film took away people’s stress for three hours,” he said.Nivin Pauly talks about his chemistry with Mamitha Baiju‘Bethlehem Kudumba Unit’ explores an unconventional age-gap romance between the lead characters. Nivin said his long-standing friendship with Mamitha Baiju helped them build a natural emotional connection on screen.“Mamitha and I have been good friends for years, so we already knew each other well. We used to talk about our dreams, cinema, family, scripts, and career choices. If she had doubts about a script or a film, she would call me and I would share advice from my experience. Because of that friendship, we did not approach the relationship in the film as two people separated by age. We approached it as two close friends working together, and that comfort helped the dynamic feel natural,” he explained.Nivin Pauly on joining the Lokesh Cinematic UniverseNivin Pauly is now part of the Lokesh Cinematic Universe (LCU) and will take on an antagonistic role, marking a change from the relaxed romantic characters audiences have often associated with him.“It is always good to surprise the audience. After doing two back-to-back feel-good romantic comedies, it felt like the right time to offer something different. Playing an antagonist will surprise them. The film is big in scale, with large sets and high-quality production, and I hope it does well. Although the villain is dark and cruel, he also has a touch of dark humour, which made the role exciting to explore,” he said.Nivin Pauly’s new film with Rukmini VasanthNivin is also working on his upcoming romantic comedy, ‘NP51’, which pairs him with Rukmini Vasanth for the first time.The actor said they had spent only a few days together on the sets and were still getting to know each other. The team then took an Onam break, followed by a period of mourning after the death of a colleague.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Quentin Tarantino reveals the first 17 minutes of The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth at special screening ahead of November release
articles.summary: Quentin Tarantino surprises fans at AFI Fest by screening the first 17 minutes of his upcoming film, The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, a sequel to Once Upon a Time in Hollywood. Join the excitement ahead of its November release!
articles.body: Fans have been waiting with full zeal and excitement over the release of ‘The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth,' which is an indirect sequel of ‘Once Upon a Time in Hollywood.' While the release date still has some time, Quentin Tarantino, the famed director behind the movie, managed to surprise fans by revealing the first 17 minutes of the upcoming film!Quentin Tarantino shows select fans the first 17 minutes of ‘The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth'While attending the AFI Fest on Friday night at the TCL Chinese Theatre in Hollywood, Tarantino had quite a surprise in store for fans, as he had a special screening of ‘Once Upon A Time In Hollywood.' While many thought that this was the only thing that they would be seeing, the filmmaker ended up playing out the first 17 minutes of the upcoming Brad Pitt film, leaving everyone in shock.The screening was then followed by a question and answer session with the filmmaker as well. The Wrap reported that he extensively talked about the movies, including how attached he is to the characters of the first film, which originally came out in 2019. He shared during the Q&A session: “It’s not about a story, the fact that it’s just about this folklore that’s a mix of real things that happened back then and real people and a real industry, and then also this kind of fantastical version that I created.”The 17 minutes from the film were exclusively screened for the fans that were attending the event and have not been released publicly.More about ‘The Further Misadventures of Cliff Booth’The film is a sequel to the 2019 film ‘Once Upon A Time In Hollywood'; however, this time around the storyline is central to Brad Pitt’s character as Cliff Booth. The film has also cast Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, and Peter Weller, among many others. Tarantino directed the first film, while he returned for the second movie as the screenplay writer.The movie will arrive in IMAX theaters on November 25 and later will be made available for streaming on Netflix from December 23 onwards.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘Jailer 2’ box office collection Day 11 [Live]: Rajinikanth’s film nears Rs 442 crore India gross, set for Sunday hike
articles.summary: Rajinikanth’s 'Jailer 2' continues to draw audiences to theatres as the action entertainer moves further into its second week.
articles.body: Rajinikanth’s 'Jailer 2' continues to draw audiences to theatres as the action entertainer moves further into its second week. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the sequel opened to strong numbers at the Indian box office and maintained its momentum during the first week. The film features Rajinikanth as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, with Mohanlal, Shivarajkumar and several other actors playing key roles. After a strong start, the film’s weekday collections have shown fluctuations, while the second weekend remains important for its overall theatrical performance.Jailer 2 Review'Jailer 2' surpassed Rs 300 crore in its first weekAccording to Sacnilk, 'Jailer 2' collected an estimated Rs 317.20 crore net in India during its first week. The film earned Rs 59.70 crore on Day 1, Rs 37.10 crore on Day 2, Rs 47.25 crore on Day 3 and Rs 55.85 crore on Day 4. It went on to collect Rs 42.35 crore on Day 5, Rs 46.80 crore on Day 6 and Rs 28.15 crore on Day 7. In the second week, the film earned Rs 17.15 crore on Day 8, Rs 14.50 crore on Day 9 and Rs 24.15 crore on Day 10.‘Jailer 2’ opens strong on Day 11 According to live box-office estimates by Sacnilk, 'Jailer 2' has collected Rs 9.20 crore net in India on Day 11, Sunday, October 25, taking its total domestic net collection to Rs 382.20 crore and gross collection to Rs 447.66 crore. The film is currently running across 5,596 shows in Tamil, Telugu and Hindi. The Tamil version leads the day's earnings with Rs 6.84 crore from 2,729 shows, followed by the Telugu version with Rs 1.46 crore from 883 shows and the Hindi version with Rs 0.90 crore from 1,984 shows. These figures are provisional and may change as the day progresses, with the final Day 11 collection yet to be reported.‘Jailer 2’ day-wise box office collectionWeek 1: Rs 317.20 croreDay 8: Rs 17.15 croreDay 9: Rs 14.50 croreDay 10: Rs 24.15 croreDay 11 [LIVE]: Rs 9.20 croreTotal India net: Rs 382.20 croreTotal India gross: Rs 447.66 croreAbout 'Jailer 2''Jailer 2' stars Rajinikanth alongside Mohanlal, Shivarajkumar, Ramya Krishnan, Mithun Chakraborty, S. articles.title: Meghan Markle sent letter to her estranged father after his amputation; she informed him that she was aware of the child sexual abuse allegation
articles.summary: Meghan Markle's last letter to her father, Thomas Markle Sr., reveals her awareness of child sexual abuse allegations against him. The letter was sent after his leg amputation, severing their ties completely and emphasizing her commitment to protect her children.
articles.body: Trigger warning: This article contains mentions of child sexual abuseThe last time that Meghan Markle contacted her estranged father, Thomas Markle Sr. was through a final letter, in which the ‘Suits’ alum told him that she was well aware of all of the child sexual abuse allegations against him. According to recent reports, this letter was sent to Thomas last year after his leg had to be amputated due to a severe blood clot.Meghan Markle’s last letter to her estranged fatherThe Sun recently reported that Markle sent a final letter to her father after his leg amputation in the Philippines. The content of the letters included her mentioning that she is cutting all ties from him, telling him that she was well aware of all of the allegations that were being investigated against him, and that she would never allow him to meet her two children.The outlet also revealed that the Duchess of Sussex made the hospital staff deliver her final letter to him at his bedside, make him sign a receipt for the letter confirming that he had received it himself, and even record a video of the entire ordeal as well.More about the case against Thomas Markle Sr.Earlier this week the outlet had reported that Meghan Markle’s father is under public scrutiny and is being investigated on the allegations of possessing materials related to child sexual abuse. The discovery of such content was reportedly made by his son, Thomas Markle Jr., the Duchess of Sussex’s half-brother.These contents were found at his home in Cebu, Philippines, separated in four large boxes that contained “hundreds, if not thousands” of child sexual abuse images, as reported by the outlet. The incident occurred earlier this year on July 10, after which Thomas Jr. “reported his discovery to the FBI Hotline, the US-based National Centre for Exploited and Missing Children, and the state police in Pennsylvania, where his father was living.”He also gave a statement to the outlet about the ongoing matter, revealing, "What I saw made me sick to the stomach—all this stuff was just dumped on me, and I didn’t know what to do. I knew right away it was highly illegal and would land me in jail for a long time if I didn’t get rid of it. I felt betrayed, angry, and disgusted—and realized I had to report him.”On the other hand, PEOPLE reported that Markle was “deeply distressed” over the matter and that her heart was with the children who have suffered because of all of this. She also revealed to the outlet that in 2018, a letter had been shared with the Metropolitan Police and Royalty and Specialist Protection about many allegations against her father, and that when she found out about the letter, she was reassured that the matter is under investigation.Her statement further continued, “I hope it can now be understood that, despite certain media publications’ distortion over the years, any distance from my father and my choice to not allow him to have contact with our children was for one reason: to protect them.”Markle had been aware of the letter since after her wedding to Prince Harry. At the time, she was advised against publicly speaking about the matter. While her father is under investigation over the matter, the MPS is also conducting an internal investigation to track and find out what happened with the letter and why it was not pursued more seriously.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Indira Dhar’s first post-wedding Durga Puja in Kolkata
articles.summary: For filmmaker Indira Dhar, this year’s Durga Puja was different from the ones she has spent in Kolkata over the years.
articles.body: For filmmaker Indira Dhar, this year’s Durga Puja was different from the ones she has spent in Kolkata over the years. Usually travelling abroad for work during October, she consciously decided to stay in the city this time, celebrating the festival with her husband, filmmaker Sayan, their son Kabir and their extended family.“It was a very conscious decision that we would be staying in Calcutta throughout Durga Puja. This year was very special because it was my first year post-marriage,” she says.The celebrations took on a traditional turn at the over 400-year-old Durga Puja of the Rajendra Mullick family in Barabazar, which dates back to 1614. Indira’s mother-in-law’s aunt, Shamuli Mullick, heads the family’s puja. The family deity is believed to have belonged to Raja Man Singh I of Amer before being brought to Kolkata and gifted to Raja Rajendra Mullick. For Indira, being part of the family’s celebrations for the first time was a memorable experience.“I had my parents, our son Kabir, my in-laws and the extended family together. It was a fantastic feeling, and I can’t explain what I felt this year,” she says.Bijoya Dashami was equally special for the family. The celebrations continued at Lake Avenue, where the Durga Puja is held at Kalidhan Institution, associated with Sayan’s great-grandfather. Sayan is now a trustee of the institution along with his father. The family took part in the worship of the deity and the traditional boron rituals.For Indira, however, the festival is also closely tied to her professional life. She says she has marked the beginning of her films with a script puja during Durga Puja for the past three years. This year was no different, as she and Sayan embarked on another project.“I worship Maa Durga every day, especially during Shashthi, and I also attend the Anjali on Ashtami morning. These are two things that the three of us, Sayan, Kabir and I, have done together,” she says.Currently working on an international film, Indira spends much of her time abroad. She credits Sayan’s understanding for helping her balance work and family life, particularly as she takes on a major project following her Bollywood debut. She also acknowledges the close bond Sayan shares with Kabir, which helps make the distance easier to manage.Recalling how her family included her in the festivities even when she was away, she says they connected over Zoom while she was abroad, allowing her to join in virtually.“Sayan and Kabir have a fantastic bonding. They take me on Zoom calls, and even this year, they called me while I was abroad so I could wish everyone. I was happy that I could connect with people,” she says.For Indira, the understanding between partners is essential to making a relationship work, particularly when both have demanding careers. “If you have a good partner, life is easy,” she says, adding that she believes Maa Durga’s blessings have played an important role in bringing them together.As the filmmaker returns to work on her next project, this year’s Puja remains memorable for more than just the rituals. It was an opportunity to embrace family traditions, celebrate with loved ones and begin another creative collaboration with Sayan.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Motivational quote of the day by Robert Downey Jr.: ‘The principle of moving forward eventually gives you confidence,’ a powerful life lesson on building self-belief through action
articles.summary: Robert Downey Jr. is one of the most well-known actors in Hollywood.
articles.body: Robert Downey Jr. is one of the most well-known actors in Hollywood. He is known for playing the role of Tony Stark (aka Iron Man) in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Due to his career being so successful, it is easy to see why what he has to say about confidence is significant. This quote was taken from an article titled ‘The Passion of Robert Downey Jr.’, which was published in Esquire in 2007.Today's Motivational Quote of the Day, “The principle of moving forward eventually gives you confidence.”Meaning behind the quote by Robert Downey Jr.It means that we do not always need to be confident to take our first step. Sometimes we have to take steps forwards even if we are doubting ourselves, then learn from our experiences and trust in ourselves.Downey is suggesting that confidence builds up over time. Looking back on your challenges and what you have achieved will make you start to trust in your abilities. This shows that sometimes we can become too focused on being fully confident to take on new opportunities.Why it is relevant now?Nowadays many people face pressure to be successful quickly. Comparing yourself to others within your career, social media and fear of failure can put people off taking risks or starting something new.Downey reminds us that we do not need to be fully confident to take steps forwards. Whether you are starting a new job, learning something new or trying to rebuild your life after facing a setback, taking your first steps will slowly build up your confidence.The quote also reminds us that we should look back on our experiences to realise how much we have grown. Whilst we may not realise how much we are progressing during a tough time, reflecting can help us see how far we have come.Early life of Robert Downey Jr.Robert John Downey Jr. was born on the 4th April 1965 in Manhattan, New York City. His father was a filmmaker named Robert Downey Sr. and his mother was an actress named Elsie Ann Ford. Growing up in a creative family meant Robert was exposed to the entertainment industry at a young age.He had his first acting role as a child in his father’s film Pound (1970), however he became more serious about his acting career and left school at the age of 16. Having been exposed to film making at a young age helped him develop a passion for acting and he moved to Hollywood.Rise to fame of Robert Downey Jr.During the 1980s Robert Downey started to gain recognition. Films such as Weird Science (1985) and Less Than Zero (1987) helped him get noticed. His portrayal of Charlie Chaplin in Chaplin (1992) earned him a nomination for Best Actor at the Academy Awards, proving he was a skilled dramatic actor.Unfortunately his career was paused due to personal issues. He struggled with substance use and legal issues. After years of struggles he slowly made a comeback with films such as The Singing Detective (2003) and Kiss Kiss Bang Bang (2005).His biggest breakthrough was in 2008 when he played Tony Stark in Iron Man. The film was a huge success and helped create the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Robert became a worldwide star and played the role in multiple films such as The Avengers (2012) and Avengers: Endgame (2019).In 2024 he won Best Supporting Actor at the Academy Awards for his role as Lewis Strauss in Oppenheimer.What we can learn from the quoteThis quote reminds us that confidence can be built up as we make decisions and overcome challenges. We do not need to know everything before we start something new.Sometimes the most important thing to do is keep moving forward. As time goes on, you will put in the effort and gain experience meaning the steps you have taken can be the reason you trust in yourself.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘Frame eh paarunga ji’; 'Jailer 2' composer Anirudh Ravichander’s special moment with 'Ramayana' composer AR Rahman goes viral
articles.summary: Music composer Anirudh Ravichander caught the attention of music lovers after sharing a picture with Oscar-winning composer AR Rahman.
articles.body: Music composer Anirudh Ravichander caught the attention of music lovers after sharing a picture with Oscar-winning composer AR Rahman. The photo went viral on social media, with fans celebrating the meeting of two popular names in Indian music. Anirudh posted the picture on his social media page with a playful caption that quickly caught fans' attention. The post also led to discussions about a possible musical collaboration between the two composers.Anirudh’s ‘Frame eh paarunga ji’ caption goes viralSharing the picture, Anirudh wrote, “Frame eh paarunga ji Always the best vibes with my goat @arrahman sir.” The opening line refers to a popular dialogue associated with Rajinikanth’s film Jailer 2. The post received an instant response from fans, who were excited to see the two composers together. AR Rahman’s son, AR Ameen, also shared the photograph on his Instagram Stories and added the song ‘Ravana Tandavam’ from the upcoming film Ramayana. The song features music by Rahman and fellow Oscar-winning composer Hans Zimmer. Anirudh and GV Prakash Kumar have sung the Tamil version of the track.‘Ramayana’ song brings Anirudh and GV Prakash together with AR RahmanThe song ‘Ravana Tandavam’ is part of director Nitesh Tiwari’s ambitious 'Ramayana,' which stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. The film has created strong interest among audiences, with its scale, cast, and music drawing attention. Anirudh and GV Prakash’s contribution to the Tamil version of the song added another interesting connection between leading composers from the Tamil film industry and Rahman’s music team. The viral photograph has also brought fresh attention to their musical association.Fans hope for an Anirudh and AR Rahman musical collaborationFans flooded the comments with reactions to the picture, with several expressing their wish to hear the two composers work together. Some even hoped AR Rahman would sing a song composed by Anirudh for Rajinikanth’s upcoming film 'Dharman.'Anirudh recently received praise for his music in Tamil films, including 'DC' and 'Jailer 2.' With fans eager to see what comes next, his latest picture with AR Rahman sparked fresh excitement about a possible collaboration.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
